home_work_agents_lead: Each task gets its own worktree: a separate copy of the code on its own branch, with its own ports, and a terminal that keeps running if you close the app. You see who is working, who needs you and who is done.
home_work_agents_more: Review the diff, comment on a line, send it back. Works with Claude Code, Codex and omp. {#link}Agents in Atlas{/link}.
home_work_agents_shot_alt: Atlas Desktop with a project's worktrees in the sidebar, an agent's terminal open in one of them
home_work_agents_title: Three agents on one project, none in another's way.
home_work_branches_alt: main branches into three agent worktrees, each with its own ports
home_work_mcp_lead: Atlas gives agents a direct line to the running project. Instead of asking you to paste an error, the agent checks the status, searches the logs and restarts a service, and anything destructive still waits for your approval.
home_work_mcp_more: It speaks MCP, the open standard agents use for tools. One command connects it: {#code}atlas setup claude-code --apply{/code}. {#link}The tools{/link}.
home_work_mcp_title: Your agent sees what you see.
home_work_stack_lead: Database, API, web app, workers: describe them once in {#code}atlas.yaml{/code}, and {#code}atlas dev{/code} starts them in the right order, waits until each one is healthy and restarts what crashes. No {#code}atlas.yaml{/code} yet? Atlas reads the project and works without one.
home_work_stack_more: One panel shows the health, logs and resource use of every service, and a service that fails says why. {#link}The atlas.yaml reference{/link}.
home_work_stack_title: Your whole project starts with one command.
